relationships.subject: TIMP-1
relationships.evidence_quote: MMP-9 acts on the basal membrane of cerebellar epithe-lium and is antagonized by TIMP-1.

key_findings: Serum TIMP-1 was lower and MMP-9/TIMP-1 ratio higher in migraine patients than controls.
MMP-9/TIMP-1 ratio correlated with pain severity.
